title: fix: renew OAuth credentials during long custom transport attempts

commit.messageHeadline: fix: renew OAuth credentials during long custom transport attempts
fix: retain account authority through request auth and refresh admission
fix: preserve scoped OAuth and release failed startup auth
fix: retain setup OAuth access and complete startup cleanup

<!-- openclaw:security-sensitive-guard -->

### ⚠️ Security sensitive changes

This maintainer PR changes sensitive security components.

**No secops approval is required. This comment is informational because the PR author has Maintain or Admin access.**

- Current SHA: `1881f6bb77c0d3f2ea5074d0d763f19cfc03906e`
- Maintainer: @hannesrudolph
- Repository role: `maintain`

These security sensitive changes were made:

- `src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth-manager.ts`: Controls credential persistence, secret resolution, or redaction. Check storage permissions, credential scope, and exposure in logs or responses.
- `src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth-manager.types.ts`: Controls credential persistence, secret resolution, or redaction. Check storage permissions, credential scope, and exposure in logs or responses.
- `src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth-store.ts`: Controls credential persistence, secret resolution, or redaction. Check storage permissions, credential scope, and exposure in logs or responses.
- `src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth.ts`: Controls credential persistence, secret resolution, or redaction. Check storage permissions, credential scope, and exposure in logs or responses.
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-controller.request-auth.ts`: Controls credential persistence, secret resolution, or redaction. Check storage permissions, credential scope, and exposure in logs or responses.
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-controller.ts`: Controls credential persistence, secret resolution, or redaction. Check storage permissions, credential scope, and exposure in logs or responses.
- `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-controller.types.ts`: Controls credential persistence, secret resolution, or redaction. Check storage permissions, credential scope, and exposure in logs or responses.
- `src/agents/model-auth-model.ts`: Controls credential persistence, secret resolution, or redaction. Check storage permissions, credential scope, and exposure in logs or responses.
- `src/agents/model-auth-provider.ts`: Controls credential persistence, secret resolution, or redaction. Check storage permissions, credential scope, and exposure in logs or responses.

Carefully review these changes before merging.

Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes This PR adds an optional per-request credential capability so custom transports can renew OAuth credentials during one long agent attempt. **Example:** A custom transport makes a private continuation after its selected OAuth access token expires. - **Before:** The continuation uses the expired token captured when the attempt started. - **After:** A participating transport resolves a renewed token for the same account before dispatch. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | The production-transport composition supports the intended repair, but a source-verifiable compatibility regression blocks merge. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Sufficient (live_output): Recorded output exercises the actual controller, canonical SQLite owner, host stream factory, custom provider transport, and guarded HTTPS against a fixture TLS server: renewal precedes private continuation, interrupted-body recovery completes, rotation persists, and canonical reconnect during DNS preparation prevents further posts; this proves the bounded transport scenario rather than a live provider or Gateway deployment. | | **Patch quality** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | 1 actionable review finding remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Long custom-transport attempts can continue sending expired OAuth access tokens on private continuation or recovery requests. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction addresses a concrete transport lifetime gap through a generic optional capability with a named downstream consumer. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 2 items remain** Keep open: this maintainer-directed fix addresses a real credential-lifetime gap, but its new authorization capture can reject supported runtime-only OAuth profiles before a turn starts. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `1881f6bb77c0d3f2ea5074d0d763f19cfc03906e` ## Before merge - [ ] **\[P1\] Exclude runtime-only OAuth profiles from canonical capture (P1)** - A provider hook can return a usable OAuth profile with `persistence: "runtime-only"`, such as `openai:external`, without any canonical credential row. The existing overlay and OAuth resolver support that input and return its access token without persisting it. This new condition nevertheless calls `captureAuthProfileAuthorization`, whose canonical read rejects the absent profile, so initialization fails before dispatch even when the transport never adopts `requestAuth`. Use the existing `runtimeExternalProfileIds` ownership metadata to omit the capability for these profiles and preserve their prior credential path; do not swallow authorization failures for genuinely stored profiles. - [ ] **Explain or restore the original intent of Runtime-only external OAuth admission** - unknown: The current public plugin contract deliberately permits external credentials without core persistence; git log -p -S could not complete because an older blob was unavailable. ## Findings - [P1] [P1] Exclude runtime-only OAuth profiles from canonical capture — `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-controller.ts:544-550` ### Provenance - `Runtime-only external OAuth admission` changes intended behavior without addressing why it exists (unknown: The current public plugin contract deliberately permits external credentials without core persistence; git log -p -S could not complete because an older blob was unavailable.)
Agent review details ### How this fits together The embedded runner selects credentials and supplies provider stream factories; custom transports consume the new capability while existing OAuth owners retain refresh and durable settlement. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Embedded run] --> B[Run auth controller] B --> C[Request auth capability] C --> D[Canonical credential resolver] D --> E[Native OAuth refresh owner] C --> F[Custom provider transport] F --> G[Guarded provider request] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Offer renewal only for canonically owned OAuth profiles while preserving runtime-only external credentials and the existing final-dispatch authority checks. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Source shows that custom transports previously received captured attempt credentials without an in-attempt renewal capability; the PR supplies a recorded expiry-and-continuation composition, which was not rerun during this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? A versioned capability on the existing auth owner is appropriate, and the lifecycle cleanup serves its retained authority, but canonical capture must remain optional for externally owned runtime profiles. Full review comments: - [P1] [P1] Exclude runtime-only OAuth profiles from canonical capture — `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-controller.ts:544-550` A provider hook can return a usable OAuth profile with `persistence: "runtime-only"`, such as `openai:external`, without any canonical credential row. The existing overlay and OAuth resolver support that input and return its access token without persisting it. This new condition nevertheless calls `captureAuthProfileAuthorization`, whose canonical read rejects the absent profile, so initialization fails before dispatch even when the transport never adopts `requestAuth`. Use the existing `runtimeExternalProfileIds` ownership metadata to omit the capability for these profiles and preserve their prior credential path; do not swallow authorization failures for genuinely stored profiles. Confidence: 0.96 Overall correctness: patch is incorrect Overall confidence: 0.94 AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [0e90c04a8a83](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0e90c04a8a833c8cf56032447eda47789a5fd9d6). ### Provenance checked - `Account authorization and OAuth refresh ownership` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172590: Keep inference bound to its authorized account while allowing same-account refresh and rejecting replacement or revocation.) - `Runtime transport admission and cleanup` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173920: Separate stable run admission from transport preparation without moving credentials to incompatible endpoints.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned introduction and current-main comparison:** Reviewed the merge-base-to-head changes; the fetched main retains the earlier auth-controller, OAuth-manager, and transport-context behavior. ([1881f6bb77c0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1881f6bb77c0d3f2ea5074d0d763f19cfc03906e)) - **Runtime-only OAuth compatibility regression:** The new capture condition checks OAuth type and runtime scope but does not exclude runtimeExternalProfileIds; captureAuthProfileAuthorization rejects a profile absent from canonical storage. ([`src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-controller.ts:545`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/1881f6bb77c0d3f2ea5074d0d763f19cfc03906e/src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/auth-controller.ts#L545), [1881f6bb77c0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1881f6bb77c0d3f2ea5074d0d763f19cfc03906e)) - **Existing external-profile contract:** Provider external profiles default to runtime-only, remain available in runtime overlays, and need not have a persisted credential row; the plugin contract explicitly supports externally managed credentials without core persistence. ([`src/agents/auth-profiles/external-auth.ts:178`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/1881f6bb77c0d3f2ea5074d0d763f19cfc03906e/src/agents/auth-profiles/external-auth.ts#L178), [1881f6bb77c0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1881f6bb77c0d3f2ea5074d0d763f19cfc03906e)) - **Usable external token needs no canonical write:** The existing OAuth manager returns a usable credential through buildValidatedOAuthAccess without creating a canonical row, so successful initial token resolution does not satisfy the new capture requirement. ([`src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth-manager.ts:892`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/1881f6bb77c0d3f2ea5074d0d763f19cfc03906e/src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth-manager.ts#L892), [1881f6bb77c0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1881f6bb77c0d3f2ea5074d0d763f19cfc03906e)) - **Recorded production-transport proof:** The full PR body records actual controller, SQLite owner, stream factory, custom provider transport, and guarded HTTPS composition: three physical posts produced AB, one renewal persisted rotation, interrupted-body recovery succeeded, and reconnect during DNS preparation resulted in zero subsequent posts. ([1881f6bb77c0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1881f6bb77c0d3f2ea5074d0d763f19cfc03906e)) - **Prior ownership decisions:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172590 establishes account continuity and revocation ownership; https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173920 separates admitted run policy from replaceable transport; this PR retains those owners. ([`src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/runtime.ts:51`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/d25a316fc7c3ea2c9685b2c287e2ab23637c52fe/src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/runtime.ts#L51), [d25a316fc7c3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d25a316fc7c3ea2c9685b2c287e2ab23637c52fe)) Likely related people: - **Peter Steinberger:** Raw commit 143d60d496c59fe38ab4dd3f7a5383c1634c9d94 adds src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth-manager.ts:20 relative to its recorded parents. This identifies author metadata, not feature responsibility or a PR merger. (role: source-line author; confidence: high; commits: [143d60d496c5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/143d60d496c59fe38ab4dd3f7a5383c1634c9d94); files: `src/agents/auth-profiles/oauth-manager.ts`) ### PR surface Source +242, Tests +909, Docs +47. Total +1198 across 21 files. Added test files: 2.

### Labels Label changes: - add `P2`: In-attempt OAuth renewal is a useful reliability repair with limited provider scope; no urgent production incident is established. - add `merge-risk: 🚨 compatibility`: The additive provider capability also introduces a mandatory persisted-authorization capture that can break existing runtime-only OAuth integrations. - add `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. - add `rating: 🦪 silver shellfish`: Overall readiness is 🦪 silver shellfish; proof is 🦐 gold shrimp and patch quality is 🦪 silver shellfish. - add `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: ClawSweeper has contributor-facing work open and is waiting for author action. Label justifications: - `P2`: In-attempt OAuth renewal is a useful reliability repair with limited provider scope; no urgent production incident is established. - `merge-risk: 🚨 compatibility`: The additive provider capability also introduces a mandatory persisted-authorization capture that can break existing runtime-only OAuth integrations. - `rating: 🦪 silver shellfish`: Overall readiness is 🦪 silver shellfish; proof is 🦐 gold shrimp and patch quality is 🦪 silver shellfish. - `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: ClawSweeper has contributor-facing work open and is waiting for author action. - `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab. Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality; ✨ marks media proof (a screenshot, video, or linked artifact) that directly shows the changed behavior. ### Workflow ClawSweeper edits this one comment on every review.
